But we should check if there's any more recent info. It's currently 2026-10-19. So maybe there was an election in 2026? Actually California gubernatorial elections happen every four years: 2018, 2022, next 2026. If it's 2026-10-19, then the 2026 election might have happened earlier in the year. Let's think: California's gubernatorial term is 4 years, starting in January after the election. The last election was November 2022, so the term started in January 2023. Next election would be November 2026, term starts January 2027. So as of October 2026, the governor is still Gavin Newsom until the inauguration in January 2027. So answer: Gavin Newsom.
